company.shortDescription: GoLinks is a company that provides tools for creating and managing internal short links for workplace knowledge access.
company.description: GoLinks is a company that builds a platform for internal short links, knowledge sharing, and enterprise search. It helps teams organize and access company resources through link-based navigation and AI-based search tools.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables users to create and share internal short links (Go Links®) for quick access to company resources and information.
productsAndServices.name: GoLinks® Knowledge Discovery & Link Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered assistant that provides fast, accurate answers to internal queries using generative AI technology.
productsAndServices.name: GoAI Assistant

productsAndServices.description: Mobile applications for iOS and Android that provide access to GoLinks® resources and short links from anywhere.
productsAndServices.name: GoLinks® Mobile Apps

productsAndServices.description: APIs and webhooks that allow custom integrations of GoLinks® with other enterprise applications and workflows.
productsAndServices.name: GoLinks® API & Webhooks

productsAndServices.description: Analytics tools that provide insights into personal and workspace GoLinks® usage, including popular and trending links.
productsAndServices.name: GoLinks® Analytics and Usage Trends

productsAndServices.description: Various types of Go Links® (variable, private, unlisted, multi-links, geo-links, aliases) and organizational features like collections and tags for managing internal links.
productsAndServices.name: GoLinks® Link Types and Management Features

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $27,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,440,893 to $131,126,684, a 12.56x increase.
